hypotheses.C0_native_replay_is_exact: Maximum native replay logit error is at most 0.02.
hypotheses.C1_declared_semantics_have_late_causal_v: The primitive declared-feature write reaches at least 0.25 full-logit causal fidelity at L17.
hypotheses.C2_residual_coordinates_add_finite_value: Adding rank-64 primitive residual coordinates improves full-logit fidelity over the semantic prediction by at least 0.15 in every layer.
hypotheses.C3_recursive_semantics_add_finite_value: The extended coarse-interaction semantic prediction improves over the primitive prediction by at least 0.03 in at least two layers.
hypotheses.C4_late_semantic_plus_residual_is_compac: At L17, primitive semantic prediction plus rank-16 residual coordinates reaches at least 0.90 full-logit fidelity.
hypotheses.C5_residual_coordinates_beat_random: Primitive rank-64 residual coordinates beat the p95 of eight equal-rank random residual subspaces in every layer.
hypotheses.C6_natural_and_semantic_residual_codes_a: Natural rank-64 write PCA and primitive semantic-plus-residual rank-64 differ by less than 0.10 fidelity in every layer.
hypotheses.C7_write_reconstruction_predicts_finite_: Observational write R2 correlates at least 0.70 with finite full-logit fidelity across methods and layers.
